title: Implement AppError type with structured responses
user_story: As an API consumer, I need every error response to include a structured JSON body with an error message and a suggestion so I can fix the issue without guessing.
description: Implement the AppError enum from CLAUDE.md using thiserror. Implement IntoResponse for Axum so every variant maps to the correct HTTP status code and returns a JSON body with `error`, `status`, and `suggestion` fields. No error is ever swallowed.

acceptance_criteria.then: the HTTP status code matches (404, 400, 429, 413, 500) and the body is JSON with `error`, `status`, and `suggestion` fields
status is 404 and suggestion is 'Check the hook ID and try again'
status is 429 and suggestion is 'Wait and retry, or increase your rate limit'

acceptance_criteria.given: an AppError::PayloadTooLarge with size and max
acceptance_criteria.then: status is 413, error message includes the size and max, and suggestion mentions --max-payload
status is 500 and suggestion is 'This is a bug — please report it'
status is 400 and the error message describes the invalid input
unit tests verify every variant's status code, JSON structure, and suggestion text
